title: Write Playwright E2E test: batch creation and management
description: Write Playwright end-to-end tests covering the main batch creation workflow. Tests that a user can create a batch with CSV import and see the prospects in the batch detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test file exists at tests/e2e/batchCreation.spec.ts
Tests cover: navigate to /batches/new, enter batch name, paste CSV data, parse, verify preview table, submit, redirect to batch detail, verify prospects in table
Tests use Page Object Model pattern

steps.description: Create Page Object for batch creation
Create Page Object for batch detail

steps.details: Test: navigate to /batches/new. Enter 'Test Roofing Batch' as name. Select 'roofing' as industry. Paste 3-row CSV. Click Parse. Assert 3 rows in preview. Click 'Create Batch'. Assert redirect to /batches/[id]. Assert 3 prospects in table.
Run `npm run test:e2e`. All tests pass against the dev server.
